paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: Comparison between PyramidInfer and full cache baseline with different batch sizes on the LLaMA 2-7B model with input length of 512+256.
model_annotation: The plot compares the throughput (in tokens per second) of PyramidInfer and the Full Cache baseline across varying batch sizes for the LLaMA 2-7B model, with an input length of 512+256. The x-axis represents the batch size, ranging from 0 to 60 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis represents throughput in tokens per second, ranging from 0 to 2500 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 500. The pink line with circular markers represents PyramidInfer, which shows a consistent upward trend: starting at approximately 100 tokens/s at batch size 10, rising to about 1400 tokens/s at batch size 30, and reaching approximately 2600 tokens/s at batch size 60. The teal line with circular markers represents the Full Cache baseline, which initially increases from about 100 tokens/s at batch size 10 to a peak of approximately 1200 tokens/s at batch size 30, then declines to around 900 tokens/s at batch size 60. The plot includes a legend in the upper left corner identifying the two methods.
